bond.prep: board paper scuffed 220 grit, not torn; cut foam edge and CF strip ends wiped with IPA; PETG 120 grit
bond.load_n: 114.9 N printed/bonded design (upper foot ult 58.8 N x 1.4375); RF 1.44 at 0.10 MPa (CL-D5-BOND-SF)
bond.load_case: L1 (landing, C1) with the C5 biased upper foot

edges.notes: field joint: press both hooks in through the side windows with the 1.5 mm hex key of the field kit (the window is recessed in the R6 wall), pull the insert out, push a pre-glued spare of the SAME COLOUR in until both click; <= 3 min (CL-D5-REPLACE-TIME). After a hard landing the hooks are inside the wall: pull the insert aft until they snap into the windows, then release. Crush stroke 38 mm toward -x; side load at the pad 59.2 N ult (C5 3-D sim, D-65), lip reaction 131 N, shoe RF 1.06 by D5 FEA (CL-D5-SIDE-RIM-SF)
